Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the estimates. We're happy to help and can offer a couple of approaches depending on how strict you need isolation to be. High-level options:

1) Hard partition: carve out dedicated GPUs for the window (strongest isolation, higher cost).
2) Soft isolation (recommended first step): priority lanes + token budget for your tenant within a shared dedicated pool, with soft preemption rules that only trigger under sustained overload.
3) Fallback model variant: automatic downgrade to a lower-capacity quantized variant when sustained overage is detected (preserves availability, reduces per-token cost).

To draft an SLA addendum I need:
- Target sustained throughput for the window (tokens/sec or RPS)
- Desired latency targets (p50/p95) and whether short tail or full-response latency matters more
- Whether you need absolute isolation (we'll scope reserved GPUs) or would accept a prioritized carveout

I attached a first-pass SLA draft for discussion (sla-draft-novafin-v1.pdf). If you can confirm the numbers I can pull pricing and a proposed addendum for procurement.
